title: Geometric uncertainty principles for Schrödinger evolutions on negatively curved manifolds
summary: In this paper, we study the uncertainty principle for Schrödinger equations with a bounded time-independent potentials on certain Cartan-Hadamard manifolds endowed with an asymptotic hyperbolic metric in dimensions $n\geq2$. The classical Hardy uncertainty principle in Euclidean space, as developed in the works of Escauriaza-Kenig-Ponce-Vega (JEMS, 2008; Duke Math. J., 2010), reveals a rigidity phenomenon for solution $u$ to Schrödinger equations: sufficiently strong Gaussian decay at two distinct times yields $u\equiv0$.
